[SWS_CM_00710] No implicit context switches
⌈
The sending of an event
on sender side shall not lead to an implicit context switch to the receiver pro-
cess, unless the receiver explicitly enabled it by following [SWS_CM_00182] and
[SWS_CM_00711].

[SWS_CM_00710] No implicit context switches
⌈
Reception of a new event
shall not lead to an implicit context switch in the receiver process when polling behavior
is employed (i.e.
No ReceiveHandler has been set via SetReceiveHandler())
⌋

[SWS_CM_00710] No implicit context switches
⌈
When no ReceiveHan-
dler has been set at the proxy side via SetReceiverHandler(), new SampleData
shall only be rececived by directly invoking GetNewSamples() (polling behaviour).
Reception of new events itself shall not lead to an implicit context switch in the local
receiver process (i.e. if only polling behavior is used). In case a SetReceiveHandler
() is enabled, a context switch shall be enforced with the reception of new events to
schedule/invoke the ReceiveHandler.
⌋
